title: Addicted to technology
subtitle: 沉迷科技、依賴科技、無法停止使用數碼裝置——哪些說法真的接近 addicted to technology？
description: 沉迷科技、依賴科技、無法停止使用數碼裝置——哪些說法真的接近 addicted to technology？

words.note: 表示一個人非常依靠科技才能完成日常活動、工作、娛樂或溝通。和 addicted to technology 很接近，但 dependent 可以只是功能性依賴，不一定包含強迫性使用。

exercises.original: Many office workers are addicted to technology because almost every task now requires a computer or phone.
exercises.upgrade: Many office workers are addicted to technology because almost every task now requires a computer or phone.

options.explanation: 重點是工作功能上高度依賴。

exercises.original: Modern students are often addicted to technology for research, communication, and submitting assignments.
exercises.upgrade: Modern students are often addicted to technology for research, communication, and submitting assignments.

options.explanation: 日常學習高度依靠科技。

exercises.original: The business has become addicted to technology to such an extent that it cannot operate during a network failure.
exercises.upgrade: The business has become addicted to technology to such an extent that it cannot operate during a network failure.

options.explanation: 通常描述人，不適合公司。

words.note: 非常接近 addicted to technology 的口語說法，語氣自然、強烈，常表示很難停止使用。

exercises.original: He seems addicted to technology and checks his phone every few minutes.
exercises.upgrade: He seems addicted to technology and checks his phone every few minutes.

options.explanation: 較正式、較不強調強迫性。

exercises.original: Some children become addicted to technology after spending most of their free time on screens.
exercises.upgrade: Some children become addicted to technology after spending most of their free time on screens.

exercises.original: She became addicted to technology during the lockdown and found it difficult to put her devices away.
exercises.upgrade: She became addicted to technology during the lockdown and found it difficult to put her devices away.

words.meaning: 沉迷數碼媒體；迷上網上內容
words.note: 表示難以停止使用社交媒體、串流平台、短片、遊戲或其他數碼內容。比 addicted to technology 更集中在媒體內容和平台。

exercises.original: He is addicted to technology mainly because he spends hours scrolling through social media.
exercises.upgrade: He is addicted to technology mainly because he spends hours scrolling through social media.

exercises.original: Many teenagers seem addicted to technology because they cannot stop watching short-form videos.
exercises.upgrade: Many teenagers seem addicted to technology because they cannot stop watching short-form videos.

exercises.original: She became addicted to technology through constant gaming, streaming, and social-media use.
exercises.upgrade: She became addicted to technology through constant gaming, streaming, and social-media use.

options.explanation: 三者都是數碼內容／平台。
可以，但不如 digital media 精準。

words.meaning: 強迫性地使用裝置；難以控制地使用電子設備
words.note: 表示一個人反覆、難以控制地使用手機、平板或其他裝置。和 addicted to technology 很接近，但更偏描述行為本身，語氣較客觀。

exercises.original: He is addicted to technology and reaches for his phone even when there is no notification.
exercises.upgrade: He is addicted to technology and reaches for his phone even when there is no notification.

options.explanation: 強調反覆、難以控制的行為。

exercises.original: She appears addicted to technology because she checks multiple devices throughout every conversation.
exercises.upgrade: She appears addicted to technology because she checks multiple devices throughout every conversation.

exercises.original: His technology addiction is most visible in the way he repeatedly unlocks his phone without any clear reason.
exercises.upgrade: His technology addiction is most visible in the way he repeatedly unlocks his phone without any clear reason.

words.note: 表示依靠科技的程度超出合理或健康水平。比 dependent on technology 多了一層「過度」的負面評價，因此更接近 addicted to technology。

exercises.original: Students may become addicted to technology if they use AI tools for every small decision.
exercises.upgrade: Students may become addicted to technology if they use AI tools for every small decision.

exercises.original: The team has become addicted to technology and struggles to work when automated systems are unavailable.
exercises.upgrade: The team has become addicted to technology and struggles to work when automated systems are unavailable.

exercises.original: Some drivers are addicted to technology to the point that they no longer feel confident navigating without GPS.
exercises.upgrade: Some drivers are addicted to technology to the point that they no longer feel confident navigating without GPS.

options.explanation: 無 GPS 就缺乏信心，是過度依賴。

words.meaning: 無法抽離科技；難以停止使用科技
words.note: 表示即使想停下來，也很難離開手機、電腦、網絡或其他科技。這個說法比 addicted 更描述性，也較少直接作出成癮判斷。

exercises.original: He seems addicted to technology because he cannot put his phone away during dinner.
exercises.upgrade: He seems addicted to technology because he cannot put his phone away during dinner.

exercises.original: Even on holiday, she is addicted to technology and keeps returning to her laptop and phone.
exercises.upgrade: Even on holiday, she is addicted to technology and keeps returning to her laptop and phone.

exercises.original: He is so addicted to technology that he becomes restless whenever he is away from his devices.
exercises.upgrade: He is so addicted to technology that he becomes restless whenever he is away from his devices.

options.explanation: 也接近，但較偏依賴程度。

words.meaning: 數碼依賴的；高度依靠數碼工具的
words.note: 較簡潔、較正式的說法，表示生活、工作或日常活動高度依靠數碼科技。與 dependent on technology 很接近。

exercises.original: Modern workplaces are increasingly addicted to technology for communication, records, and scheduling.
exercises.upgrade: Modern workplaces are increasingly addicted to technology for communication, records, and scheduling.

options.explanation: 正式描述系統性數碼依賴。

exercises.original: Many households are now addicted to technology for banking, shopping, entertainment, and communication.
exercises.upgrade: Many households are now addicted to technology for banking, shopping, entertainment, and communication.

options.explanation: 日常生活多方面依靠數碼科技。

exercises.original: The education system has become addicted to technology for teaching materials, assessments, and communication.
exercises.upgrade: The education system has become addicted to technology for teaching materials, assessments, and communication.

options.explanation: 制度層面的依賴最自然。

falseSynonyms.zh: 熟悉科技不等於沉迷科技 Tech-savvy 表示善於使用科技，是能力；addicted to technology 表示難以停止或過度依賴。
falseSynonyms.point: She is very tech-savvy and learns new software quickly. He is hooked on technology and checks his phone constantly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡科技不等於上癮 對科技有興趣可以完全健康、受控制。
高頻使用不等於成癮 使用時間很多不一定表示失去控制或無法停止。
經常在線不一定表示依賴 可能是工作要求，也可能是生活方式。
數碼連接程度高不等於沉迷 Digitally connected 通常是中性描述。
只靠螢幕不等於所有科技依賴 Screen-dependent 比較集中在螢幕裝置，範圍比 technology 窄。
著迷科技不完全等於強迫性使用 Obsessive about technology 可以表示強烈興趣或執著，但不一定意味著實際使用失去控制。
可以只是功能依賴 例如一間公司 technology-dependent，並不表示「上癮」。
